name: Calliope Seymour
source:
Callie exudes confidence, takes no shit, and has a heart of solid gold. You can often find her in the Vanguard Lounge, serenading the crowds with her unforgettable voice. The Songbird's extroverted nature and her eagerness to talk ensures she stays on top of Penny's list of informants. As with most of Styx's residents, there's far more to her than meets the eye, even if she does like to pretend all her cards are already on the table.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lunarisgames/call-me-under-a-queer-1950s-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter[/url]]

Callie can be romanced on her own or as part of a polyamorous triad with Penny.
